text_blocks.snippet: The COVID-19 pandemic has had a significant and widespread impact on mental health, leading to increased rates of anxiety, depression, and substance use disorders. Many individuals experienced mental health challenges during the pandemic, and some are still grappling with its effects. The pandemic has also highlighted the need for accessible mental health services and has spurred research into the long-term mental health consequences of COVID-19, including the effects of Long COVID.
